name: vibe-catalysis
description: Build, import, relax, compare, and visualize heterogeneous-catalysis adsorption structures with ASE and FAIR-Chem UMA.

interface.shortDescription: Run ASE + UMA adsorption workflows from natural language.
interface.longDescription: Generate elemental surfaces or import user-supplied catalyst structures including COFs, MOFs, oxides, and supported catalysts. Existing C/O/N/H remain framework atoms; selected active atoms or coordinates define adsorption sites for UMA calculation and visualization.
defaultPrompt: Calculate CO adsorption on Cu(111) and compare sites.
Use my uploaded POSCAR to calculate and plot CO adsorption.
Use active atoms 18, 24, and 31 in my uploaded COF CIF to screen CO adsorption sites.
Relax CHO on Fe(110) with the bottom layers fixed.
Compare CO and CHO adsorption and draw an energy profile.
